name: The Vending Machine Choir
idea: Each vending machine here hums its own note. Hear them all and they sing together.

say: A vending machine hums a low note, steady as a held breath. It seems to be waiting for the others.
then: Three notes heard. Back at the first machine, the low hum has changed.
found: All three notes at once: a chord nobody wrote. The machine drops a warm can of corn soup.
Too big for a kitten. Under it, a station stamp someone left for you.

say: A vending machine hums a middle note, a little flat.
A vending machine sings the high note. Its lights flicker in time.
From here the hum is only a feeling in the floor.
